svg.title: The Millennium Problems · Figure 2 · The Ten Steps Across The Seven Rows
svg.text: THE TEN STEPS ACROSS THE SEVEN ROWS
theorem over a cited published result
EACH ROW'S TEN STEPS, BY EXACT TYPE
A cell carries the cone of the row's bound ten-step theorem, named below in row order. Steps 1 to 9 are theorems on every row; at five rows Step 8 takes the
published real part as a structure field. Step 10 proves that either kind of delivery yields the sentence, the delivery itself a premise on all seven rows; the Poincaré
delivery was accepted as unconditional by the Clay Institute.
